import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {
    public static boolean isValid(int[] f, int p, int k) {
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (f[(k * i) % p] != (k * f[i]) % p) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static int countFArrays(java.util.List<Integer> f, int p, int k, int position) {
        if (position == p) {
            int[] arr = f.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
            return isValid(arr, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int val = 0; val < p; val++) {
            f.add(val);
            total += countFArrays(f, p, k, position + 1);
            f.remove(f.size() - 1);
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static long calculate(int p, int k) {
        int groupCount = 0;
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
        for (int start = 0; start < p; start++) {
            if (!visited.contains(start)) {
                groupCount++;
            }
            int current = start;
            while (!visited.contains(current)) {
                visited.add(current);
                current = (current * k) % p;
            }
        }
        long mod = 1000000007L;
        long exponent = groupCount - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
        long result = pow(p, exponent, mod);
        return result;
    }

    public static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(calculate(p, k));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
